After check-in, relax before visiting the famous Mughal Gardens including Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Chashme Shahi. In the evening enjoy a peaceful Shikara Ride on Dal Lake while admiring the floating gardens and houseboats. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

fields.name: Dal Lake
fields.title: Dal Lake
fields.description: After breakfast proceed to Gulmarg, known as the Meadow of Flowers. Enjoy panoramic mountain views and optional Gondola Cable Car ride to Kongdoori and Apharwat Peak. Experience snow activities during winter or scenic meadows during summer. Return to Srinagar for overnight stay

fields.name: Pahalgam Excursion
fields.title: Pahalgam Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast drive to Pahalgam. En route visit Pampore Saffron Fields, Awantipora Ruins, and Apple Orchards. Explore Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and Lidder River (optional local union vehicle). Enjoy nature photography and shopping before returning to Srinagar.

fields.name: Sonamarg Day Trip
fields.title: Sonamarg Day Trip
fields.description: After breakfast visit Sonamarg, the Meadow of Gold. Witness glaciers, Sindh River, lush valleys, and breathtaking Himalayan scenery. Optional pony ride to Thajiwas Glacier. Return to Srinagar by evening

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel. Transfer to Srinagar Airport with wonderful memories of Kashmir.

fields.name: Arrival in Leh – Acclimatization
fields.title: Arrival in Leh – Acclimatization
fields.description: Arrive at Leh Airport (11,500 ft). Meet our representative and transfer to the hotel. Due to the high altitude, complete rest is recommended for the remainder of the day to allow your body to acclimatize. In the evening, if your health permits, enjoy a leisurely walk through Leh Market.

fields.name: Sham Valley Sightseeing
fields.title: Sham Valley Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, begin a full-day excursion covering Hall of Fame Museum, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, Magnetic Hill, Sangam Point (Indus & Zanskar Rivers), and SECMOL School (Rancho School). Return to Leh in the evening. Visit Shanti Stupa for a panoramic sunset view before heading back to the hotel.

fields.name: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
fields.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
fields.description: Drive through the famous Khardung La Pass, one of the highest motorable roads in the world. Arrive in Nubra Valley and visit Diskit Monastery and the Hunder Sand Dunes. Enjoy an optional double-humped Bactrian camel ride before checking into your camp or hotel.

fields.name: Nubra Valley to Pangong Lake
fields.title: Nubra Valley to Pangong Lake
fields.description: After breakfast, travel through the scenic Shyok route toward the iconic Pangong Lake. Witness the changing shades of the lake surrounded by majestic mountains. Spend the evening enjoying the peaceful lakeside atmosphere before an overnight stay.

fields.name: Pangong Lake to Leh
fields.title: Pangong Lake to Leh
fields.description: Wake up early to witness the sunrise over Pangong Lake. After breakfast, return to Leh via Chang La Pass. Visit Druk White Lotus School (if time permits) and enjoy free time for shopping in Leh Market.

fields.name: Departure from Leh
fields.title: Departure from Leh
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Leh Airport with unforgettable memories of your Ladakh adventure.

fields.name: Arrival in Manali
fields.title: Arrival in Manali
fields.description: Arrive in Manali and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in process. Spend the rest of the day relaxing amidst the cool mountain air. In the evening, explore Mall Road, local cafés, handicraft shops, and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel Excursion
fields.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Solang Valley, one of Manali's most popular attractions. Enjoy breathtaking mountain views and optional adventure activities such as paragliding, ziplining, skiing (seasonal), snow scooter rides, and ATV rides. Continue to the Atal Tunnel, one of the world's longest highway tunnels at high altitude. Return to the hotel in the evening.

fields.name: Kullu Valley Sightseeing
fields.title: Kullu Valley Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, drive to Kullu Valley. Visit the Vaishno Devi Temple, Shawl Factory, local apple orchards (seasonal), and enjoy optional river rafting on the Beas River. Return to Manali in the evening and spend leisure time shopping on Mall Road.

fields.name: Manali Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the famous Hidimba Devi Temple, Ghatotkach Temple, Vashisht Hot Water Springs, Tibetan Monastery, Club House, Van Vihar, and nearby local attractions. Enjoy the scenic beauty and capture memorable photographs before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and begin your return journey with wonderful memories of your Manali holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Shimla
fields.title: Arrival in Shimla
fields.description: Arrive in Shimla and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. Relax and enjoy the pleasant mountain weather. In the evening, visit Mall Road and The Ridge, explore local cafés, shop for handicrafts, and admire the colonial charm of the hill station. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Kufri Excursion & Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Kufri Excursion & Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Kufri, one of Shimla's most popular attractions. Enjoy panoramic Himalayan views and optional activities such as horse riding, yak rides, and adventure sports. Visit Himalayan Nature Park before returning to Shimla. En route, stop at Green Valley for photography.

fields.name: Shimla Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Shimla Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Jakhoo Temple, dedicated to Lord Hanuman, followed by Christ Church, Scandal Point, Lakkar Bazaar, Gaiety Theatre (outside view), and the State Museum (optional). Spend the evening shopping or relaxing at Mall Road.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and begin your return journey with unforgettable memories of your Shimla holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Jaipur
fields.title: Arrival in Jaipur
fields.description: Arrive in Jaipur and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, visit Birla Temple and the beautifully illuminated Albert Hall Museum (outside view). Later, explore Bapu Bazaar for local handicrafts, textiles, jewelry, and traditional Rajasthani souvenirs before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Jaipur Heritage Sightseeing
fields.title: Jaipur Heritage Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the magnificent Amber Fort and enjoy its stunning architecture and panoramic hilltop views. Continue to Jal Mahal for a photo stop, followed by a visit to the City Palace and Jantar Mantar. End the day with a photo stop at the iconic Hawa Mahal before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Nahargarh Fort & Local Exploration
fields.title: Nahargarh Fort & Local Exploration
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Nahargarh Fort for breathtaking views of Jaipur city. Continue to Patrika Gate, one of Jaipur’s most Instagram-worthy landmarks. Spend the afternoon exploring Johari Bazaar, famous for gemstones, jewelry, textiles, and traditional Rajasthani handicrafts. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of the royal city of Jaipur.

fields.name: Arrival in Udaipur
fields.title: Arrival in Udaipur
fields.description: Arrive in Udaipur and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, enjoy a leisurely walk around Fateh Sagar Lake and explore the nearby local markets. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Udaipur City Sightseeing
fields.title: Udaipur City Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the magnificent City Palace, one of Rajasthan's largest palace complexes. Continue to Jagdish Temple, followed by Saheliyon Ki Bari, known for its beautiful fountains and gardens. In the evening, enjoy an optional boat ride on Lake Pichola while admiring Jag Mandir and the scenic lake views.

fields.name: Monsoon Palace & Local Attractions
fields.title: Monsoon Palace & Local Attractions
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Sajjangarh (Monsoon Palace) for panoramic views of Udaipur. Continue to the Vintage Car Museum (optional) and Karni Mata Temple via ropeway (optional). In the evening, enjoy the cultural performance at Bagore Ki Haveli (optional) before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of the beautiful City of Lakes.

fields.name: Arrival in Agra & Local Exploration
fields.title: Arrival in Agra & Local Exploration
fields.description: Arrive in Agra and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the afternoon, visit Mehtab Bagh for stunning views of the Taj Mahal across the Yamuna River. Later, explore Kinari Bazaar and Sadar Bazaar for handicrafts, leather goods, marble souvenirs, and local delicacies. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Taj Mahal & Agra Fort Sightseeing
fields.title: Taj Mahal & Agra Fort Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the world-famous Taj Mahal and admire its breathtaking Mughal architecture. Continue to the UNESCO-listed Agra Fort, followed by a visit to Itmad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj). Later, stop at a traditional marble inlay workshop to witness the craftsmanship that Agra is famous for before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Sikandra & Departure
fields.title: Sikandra & Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and visit Akbar's Tomb at Sikandra (time permitting). Proceed for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Agra's rich heritage and architectural wonders.

fields.name: Arrival in Varanasi & Evening Ganga Aarti
fields.title: Arrival in Varanasi & Evening Ganga Aarti
fields.description: Arrive in Varanasi and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, visit Dashashwamedh Ghat to witness the spectacular Ganga Aarti, a spiritually uplifting ceremony performed on the banks of the River Ganges. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Temple Tour & Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Temple Tour & Local Sightseeing
fields.description: Start your day with an optional sunrise boat ride on the River Ganges. After breakfast, visit the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Annapurna Temple, Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple, Tulsi Manas Temple, Durga Temple, and Banaras Hindu University (outside view). Spend the evening exploring local markets famous for Banarasi silk sarees and handicrafts.

fields.name: Sarnath Excursion
fields.title: Sarnath Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Sarnath, the place where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon. Visit Dhamek Stupa, Chaukhandi Stupa, Sarnath Archaeological Museum (closed on Fridays), Mulagandha Kuti Vihara, and the Ashoka Pillar site. Return to Varanasi and enjoy free time for shopping or leisure.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to the airport or railway station with unforgettable memories of the spiritual city of Varanasi.

fields.name: Arrival in Rishikesh & Ganga Aarti
fields.title: Arrival in Rishikesh & Ganga Aarti
fields.description: Arrive in Rishikesh and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, visit Triveni Ghat to witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti. Later, explore the local market and riverside cafés before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Adventure Activities & Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Adventure Activities & Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy optional white-water rafting on the River Ganga (seasonal and weather permitting). Adventure lovers can also try bungee jumping, giant swing, ziplining, or flying fox (optional). Later, visit Laxman Jhula, Ram Jhula, Parmarth Niketan, and the Beatles Ashram before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple Excursion
fields.title: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to the sacred Neelkanth Mahadev Temple surrounded by lush forests and scenic hills. Return to Rishikesh and spend the evening shopping for handicrafts, spiritual souvenirs, Ayurvedic products, and local delicacies.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Rishikesh.

fields.name: Arrival at Joshimath
fields.title: Arrival at Joshimath
fields.description: Arrive at Haridwar or Rishikesh and begin your scenic drive to Joshimath through Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag, and Chamoli. Check in to the hotel upon arrival and relax. Enjoy the peaceful mountain surroundings before dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Joshimath to Auli Sightseeing
fields.title: Joshimath to Auli Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, travel to Auli by road or enjoy the famous Auli Ropeway (optional). Visit the Auli Artificial Lake, enjoy breathtaking views of Nanda Devi, and explore the nearby viewpoints. Spend the evening amidst the serene Himalayan landscape before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Auli Adventure & Snow Activities
fields.title: Auli Adventure & Snow Activities
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy optional skiing, snowboarding, chair lift rides, or a trek to Gurso Bugyal (depending on the season). Capture spectacular views of snow-covered mountains and alpine meadows. Return to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Joshimath Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Joshimath Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the sacred Narsingh Temple, Shankaracharya Math, and local markets in Joshimath. Spend the afternoon at leisure enjoying the mountain scenery before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive back to Haridwar or Rishikesh with unforgettable memories of your Himalayan holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Goa
fields.title: Arrival in Goa
fields.description: Arrive at Goa Airport or Railway Station and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. Spend the evening relaxing at Calangute Beach or Baga Beach. Enjoy the lively atmosphere, beach cafés, and local seafood before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: North Goa Sightseeing
fields.title: North Goa Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day North Goa sightseeing tour covering Fort Aguada, Sinquerim Beach, Candolim Beach, Calangute Beach, Baga Beach, and Anjuna Beach. Enjoy optional water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, banana boat rides, and bumper rides. Return to the hotel in the evening.

fields.name: South Goa Sightseeing
fields.title: South Goa Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, St. Augustine Tower (outside view), Dona Paula View Point, Miramar Beach, and Panaji Church. In the evening, enjoy an optional sunset cruise on the Mandovi River with live music and cultural performances.

fields.name: Leisure Day / Dudhsagar Waterfall (Optional)
fields.title: Leisure Day / Dudhsagar Waterfall (Optional)
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy the day at leisure or choose an optional excursion to Dudhsagar Waterfall and Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary (subject to season and government regulations). Alternatively, relax at the beach, explore local cafés, or shop at Mapusa Market or Anjuna Flea Market (seasonal).

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Goa Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of your beach holiday.

fields.name: Arrival at Kochi – Transfer to Munnar
fields.title: Arrival at Kochi – Transfer to Munnar
fields.description: Arrive at Kochi Airport or Ernakulam Railway Station and meet our representative. Drive through the scenic Western Ghats to Munnar, stopping at Cheeyappara Waterfalls, Valara Waterfalls, and spice plantations en route. Check in to your hotel and relax. Enjoy the cool climate and beautiful surroundings before dinner.

fields.name: Munnar Full-Day Sightseeing
fields.title: Munnar Full-Day Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Eravikulam National Park, home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr. Continue to the Tea Museum to learn about tea production, followed by visits to Rose Garden, Photo Point, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake. Return to the hotel in the evening.

fields.name: Top Station & Leisure
fields.title: Top Station & Leisure
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Top Station for panoramic views of the Western Ghats and Tamil Nadu valley. Later, explore Blossom Hydel Park and local spice gardens. Spend the evening shopping for tea, spices, homemade chocolates, and handicrafts at the Munnar Market.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive back to Kochi Airport or Ernakulam Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Munnar.

fields.name: Arrival at Alleppey
fields.title: Arrival at Alleppey
fields.description: Arrive at Kochi Airport or Ernakulam Railway Station and transfer to Alleppey. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, visit Alleppey Beach and the historic Alappuzha Lighthouse. Enjoy the peaceful sunset before returning to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Backwater Cruise Experience
fields.title: Backwater Cruise Experience
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a scenic backwater cruise through the canals of Alleppey (or upgrade to an optional houseboat day cruise). Witness traditional village life, coconut groves, paddy fields, and the beautiful Vembanad Lake. Return to the hotel in the evening.

fields.name: Marari Beach & Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Marari Beach & Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the peaceful Marari Beach, followed by Ambalapuzha Sri Krishna Temple. Explore local coir-making units, village markets, and traditional handicraft shops. Spend the evening at leisure enjoying Kerala's natural beauty.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Kochi Airport or Ernakulam Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Kerala's enchanting backwaters.

fields.name: Arrival in Ooty
fields.title: Arrival in Ooty
fields.description: Arrive at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station and meet our representative. Enjoy a scenic drive through the Nilgiri Hills to Ooty. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, visit Ooty Lake for boating (optional) and explore the nearby local market famous for homemade chocolates, eucalyptus oil, spices, and handicrafts.

fields.name: Ooty Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Ooty Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Doddabetta Peak, the highest point in the Nilgiris, offering spectacular panoramic views. Continue to the Government Botanical Garden, Government Rose Garden, Tea Factory & Tea Museum, and the Wax Museum. Return to the hotel in the evening after a full day of sightseeing.

fields.name: Pykara & Pine Forest Excursion
fields.title: Pykara & Pine Forest Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Pykara Lake and Pykara Waterfalls. Enjoy optional boating before visiting the famous Pine Forest and Shooting Point, known for their scenic beauty and appearances in popular Indian films. Return to Ooty in the evening for leisure and shopping.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station with unforgettable memories of your Ooty holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Kodaikanal
fields.title: Arrival in Kodaikanal
fields.description: Arrive at Madurai Airport or Railway Station and meet our representative. Enjoy a scenic drive through the Western Ghats to Kodaikanal. En route, stop at the beautiful Silver Cascade Falls. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, enjoy boating (optional) or a peaceful walk around Kodaikanal Lake and explore the local market.

fields.name: Kodaikanal Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Kodaikanal Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the famous Coaker's Walk for panoramic valley views. Continue to Bryant Park, Green Valley View, Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), Pine Forest, and Moir Point. Capture stunning photographs before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Temple Visit & Leisure
fields.title: Temple Visit & Leisure
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Kurinji Andavar Temple, Chettiar Park, and the Solar Observatory (outside view, subject to entry availability). Spend the afternoon shopping for homemade chocolates, eucalyptus oil, spices, handmade crafts, and local products. Enjoy the cool mountain climate before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Madurai Airport or Railway Station with unforgettable memories of your Kodaikanal holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Coorg
fields.title: Arrival in Coorg
fields.description: Arrive at Bengaluru Airport or Railway Station and meet our representative. Enjoy a scenic drive to Coorg through picturesque countryside and coffee plantations. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, visit Raja's Seat to witness a spectacular sunset and enjoy the beautiful garden surroundings.

fields.name: Coorg Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Coorg Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the beautiful Abbey Falls surrounded by lush greenery. Continue to a coffee plantation to learn about coffee cultivation and processing. Later, visit Madikeri Fort (outside view if preferred), Omkareshwara Temple, and spend the evening shopping for Coorg coffee, spices, chocolates, and local handicrafts.

fields.name: Dubare Elephant Camp & Talacauvery
fields.title: Dubare Elephant Camp & Talacauvery
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the famous Dubare Elephant Camp where you can observe and interact with elephants (activities subject to timing). Continue to Talacauvery, the origin of the River Cauvery, and Bhagamandala Temple. On the return journey, visit the Golden Temple (Namdroling Monastery) at Bylakuppe.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive back to Bengaluru Airport or Railway Station with unforgettable memories of your Coorg holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Mysuru
fields.title: Arrival in Mysuru
fields.description: Arrive at Bengaluru Airport/Railway Station or Mysuru Railway Station and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, visit the magnificent Brindavan Gardens and enjoy the famous musical fountain show. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Mysuru Heritage Sightseeing
fields.title: Mysuru Heritage Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the grand Mysore Palace, one of India's most beautiful royal residences. Continue to St. Philomena's Church, Mysore Zoo, Chamundi Hills, Chamundeshwari Temple, and the giant Nandi Statue. Spend the evening shopping for Mysore silk sarees, sandalwood products, and traditional handicrafts at Devaraja Market.

fields.name: Srirangapatna Excursion
fields.title: Srirangapatna Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Srirangapatna to visit the historic Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace (Daria Daulat Bagh), Gumbaz Mausoleum, Sriranganathaswamy Temple, and nearby historical monuments. Return to Mysuru in the evening for leisure.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Bengaluru Airport/Railway Station or Mysuru Railway Station with wonderful memories of your royal Mysuru holiday.

fields.name: Arrival at Gangtok
fields.title: Arrival at Gangtok
fields.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport or New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Railway Station and meet our representative. Enjoy a scenic drive to Gangtok through the beautiful Teesta River valley. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, explore MG Marg, famous for shopping, cafés, and local cuisine.

fields.name: Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir Excursion
fields.title: Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to the breathtaking Tsomgo Lake located at an altitude of approximately 12,400 feet. Continue to Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir, a famous shrine dedicated to an Indian Army soldier. Enjoy the stunning mountain landscapes and optional yak rides before returning to Gangtok.   (Nathula Pass visit can be arranged at an additional cost, subject to permit availability and weather conditions.)

fields.name: Gangtok Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Gangtok Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Tashi View Point, Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok, Rumtek Monastery, Banjhakri Waterfalls, Flower Exhibition Centre, and the Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom. Spend the evening shopping for traditional handicrafts, woollen garments, tea, and souvenirs.

fields.name: Leisure Day / Optional Nathula Pass
fields.title: Leisure Day / Optional Nathula Pass
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a free day to explore Gangtok at your own pace or opt for a full-day excursion to Nathula Pass (subject to permit availability, weather conditions, and additional charges). Spend the evening relaxing at MG Marg.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Bagdogra Airport or New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Railway Station with unforgettable memories of your Sikkim holiday.

fields.name: Arrival at Shillong
fields.title: Arrival at Shillong
fields.description: Arrive at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station and meet our representative. Drive to Shillong via the picturesque Umiam Lake, where you can stop for photography and enjoy the scenic surroundings. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, explore Police Bazaar for shopping and local cuisine.

fields.name: Shillong Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Shillong Local Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Shillong Peak for panoramic city views, followed by Elephant Falls, Ward's Lake, Don Bosco Museum, Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians, and Lady Hydari Park. Return to the hotel in the evening.

fields.name: Mawlynnong & Dawki Excursion
fields.title: Mawlynnong & Dawki Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Mawlynnong, renowned as one of Asia's cleanest villages. Explore the Living Root Bridge and the Sky View Point before continuing to Dawki. Enjoy the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River with an optional boating experience. Return to Shillong in the evening.

fields.name: Laitlum Canyons & Leisure
fields.title: Laitlum Canyons & Leisure
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the spectacular Laitlum Canyons, known for breathtaking valley views and trekking trails. Spend the afternoon shopping at Police Bazaar or Bara Bazaar for handicrafts, spices, local food products, and souvenirs.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station with unforgettable memories of your Meghalaya holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Darjeeling
fields.title: Arrival in Darjeeling
fields.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport or New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Railway Station and meet our representative. Enjoy a scenic drive through the Himalayan foothills to Darjeeling. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, explore Chowrasta and Mall Road, known for cafés, handicrafts, woollen garments, and local delicacies.

fields.name: Tiger Hill Sunrise & Local Sightseeing
fields.title: Tiger Hill Sunrise & Local Sightseeing
fields.description: Early morning, drive to Tiger Hill to witness the spectacular sunrise over Mount Kanchenjunga (weather permitting). On the return journey, visit Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop. After breakfast, continue to the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tenzing Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre (subject to opening), and a local tea garden.

fields.name: Darjeeling Local Exploration
fields.title: Darjeeling Local Exploration
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the Japanese Temple and Peace Pagoda. Enjoy an optional ride on the famous Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train) or the Ropeway for panoramic views of the hills and tea gardens. Spend the evening shopping at Chowrasta and local markets.

fields.name: Leisure Day & Tea Estate Visit
fields.title: Leisure Day & Tea Estate Visit
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a relaxed day exploring nearby tea estates, local cafés, and viewpoints. Visit Happy Valley Tea Estate (subject to opening) to learn about tea processing and enjoy tea tasting. The remaining day is free for leisure or optional sightseeing.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Bagdogra Airport or New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Railway Station with unforgettable memories of your Darjeeling holiday.

fields.name: Arrival in Puri
fields.title: Arrival in Puri
fields.description: Arrive at Bhubaneswar Airport or Railway Station and meet our representative. Drive to Puri and check in to your hotel. In the evening, visit the famous Puri Golden Beach to enjoy the sunset and relax by the Bay of Bengal. Explore the local beach market before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Jagannath Temple & Konark Excursion
fields.title: Jagannath Temple & Konark Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the sacred Jagannath Temple for darshan (non-Hindus are not permitted inside the temple premises). Continue to the UNESCO-listed Konark Sun Temple, followed by a visit to Chandrabhaga Beach. En route, stop at Ramachandi Temple and return to Puri in the evening.

fields.name: Chilika Lake & Heritage Village
fields.title: Chilika Lake & Heritage Village
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Satapada on Chilika Lake. Enjoy an optional boat ride to spot Irrawaddy dolphins (subject to season and availability) and visit Kalijai Temple (optional). On the return journey, explore Raghurajpur Heritage Craft Village, famous for Pattachitra paintings and traditional handicrafts.

fields.name: Bhubaneswar Sightseeing & Departure
fields.title: Bhubaneswar Sightseeing & Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Bhubaneswar. Visit Lingaraj Temple (outside view for non-Hindus), Mukteswara Temple, Rajarani Temple, and Khandagiri & Udayagiri Caves (time permitting). Transfer to Bhubaneswar Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories.

fields.name: Arrival in Bhuj
fields.title: Arrival in Bhuj
fields.description: Arrive at Ahmedabad Airport/Railway Station or Bhuj Airport/Railway Station and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Bhuj and complete the check-in process. In the evening, explore Bhuj local market, famous for Kutchi embroidery, handicrafts, bandhani textiles, leather products, and traditional souvenirs.

fields.name: White Rann & Kala Dungar
fields.title: White Rann & Kala Dungar
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to the spectacular White Rann of Kutch. En route, visit Kala Dungar (Black Hill), the highest point in Kutch, offering panoramic views of the Great Rann. Continue to Dhordo Village and witness the endless white salt desert. Enjoy a breathtaking sunset and, during the Rann Utsav season (November to February), experience traditional Gujarati folk music, dance, handicrafts, and local cuisine.

fields.name: Mandvi Excursion
fields.title: Mandvi Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, drive to Mandvi, a beautiful coastal town. Visit the magnificent Vijay Vilas Palace, relax at Mandvi Beach, and explore the traditional shipbuilding yard (subject to access). Return to Bhuj in the evening.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Bhuj or Ahmedabad Airport/Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of the White Desert and the rich culture of Kutch.

fields.name: Arrival at Kevadia
fields.title: Arrival at Kevadia
fields.description: Arrive at Ahmedabad Airport/Railway Station or Ekta Nagar Railway Station and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Kevadia and complete the check-in process. In the evening, visit the Valley of Flowers and enjoy the spectacular Laser Light & Sound Show at the Statue of Unity. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

fields.name: Statue of Unity Sightseeing
fields.title: Statue of Unity Sightseeing
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the magnificent Statue of Unity and explore the Viewing Gallery, Museum, Audio Visual Gallery, and Sardar Patel Memorial. Continue to the Narmada Dam View Point, Jungle Safari, Butterfly Garden, Cactus Garden, Ekta Nursery, and Children's Nutrition Park (optional). Spend the evening shopping for local handicrafts and souvenirs.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. If time permits, visit Zarwani Waterfall or enjoy a leisurely walk around the Ekta Riverfront before transferring to Ahmedabad Airport/Railway Station or Ekta Nagar Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories.

fields.name: Arrival in Singapore
fields.title: Arrival in Singapore
fields.description: Arrive at Singapore Changi International Airport. Meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, relax before visiting Marina Bay Waterfront and Merlion Park. Witness the spectacular Spectra Light & Water Show in the evening before returning to your hotel.

fields.name: Singapore City Tour & Gardens by the Bay
fields.title: Singapore City Tour & Gardens by the Bay
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour covering Merlion Park, Civic District, Parliament House, Esplanade, Chinatown, Little India, Kampong Glam, and Orchard Road. Later, visit the beautiful Gardens by the Bay and explore the Flower Dome and Cloud Forest (optional ticket).

fields.name: Sentosa Island Excursion
fields.title: Sentosa Island Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Sentosa Island via scenic cable car (optional). Visit Madame Tussauds Singapore (optional), enjoy the Skyline Luge (optional), relax at Siloso Beach, and conclude your day with the spectacular Wings of Time show.

fields.name: Universal Studios / Leisure
fields.title: Universal Studios / Leisure
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day visit to Universal Studios Singapore (optional package upgrade) featuring thrilling rides, movie-themed attractions, and entertainment. Guests not visiting Universal Studios can enjoy shopping at Orchard Road or explore Clarke Quay and Bugis Street.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Singapore Changi Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Singapore.

fields.name: Arrival in Bangkok – Transfer to Pattaya
fields.title: Arrival in Bangkok – Transfer to Pattaya
fields.description: Arrive at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi International Airport and meet our representative. Transfer to Pattaya by comfortable coach/private vehicle. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, explore Pattaya Beach and the famous Walking Street at your leisure.

fields.name: Coral Island Tour
fields.title: Coral Island Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a thrilling speedboat ride to Coral Island (Koh Larn). Relax on the white sandy beaches or enjoy optional water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, banana boat rides, and sea walking. Return to Pattaya and spend the evening at leisure or attend the optional Alcazar Cabaret Show.

fields.name: Pattaya to Bangkok City Tour
fields.title: Pattaya to Bangkok City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Bangkok. En route, visit Gems Gallery. Upon arrival, enjoy a city tour covering Golden Buddha Temple (Wat Traimit), Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), and drive past key city landmarks. Check in to your hotel and enjoy free time for shopping at MBK Center or ICONSIAM.

fields.name: Bangkok Leisure / Optional Tours
fields.title: Bangkok Leisure / Optional Tours
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a free day or choose optional excursions to Safari World & Marine Park, Dream World, Ancient City, Floating Market, or Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise. Spend the evening exploring Bangkok's vibrant nightlife or shopping districts.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Bangkok Suvarnabhumi International Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Thailand.

fields.name: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
fields.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
fields.description: Arrive at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA) and meet our representative. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, visit Bukit Bintang, Malaysia's famous entertainment and shopping district, and enjoy local cuisine before returning to your hotel.

fields.name: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
fields.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour covering the Petronas Twin Towers (photo stop), King's Palace (Istana Negara), National Monument, National Mosque (photo stop), Merdeka Square, Sultan Abdul Samad Building, and Central Market. Spend the evening shopping at Pavilion Kuala Lumpur or Suria KLCC.

fields.name: Genting Highlands Excursion
fields.title: Genting Highlands Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, drive to Genting Highlands. En route, visit the famous Batu Caves and continue to Genting via the Awana SkyWay Cable Car (subject to operation). Spend the day enjoying Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park (optional), casino (for eligible visitors), shopping, and entertainment before returning to Kuala Lumpur.

fields.name: Putrajaya Tour & Leisure
fields.title: Putrajaya Tour & Leisure
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Putrajaya, Malaysia's administrative capital. Explore Putra Mosque, Putrajaya Lake, Seri Wawasan Bridge, and Perdana Putra (Prime Minister's Office - exterior). Return to Kuala Lumpur for leisure, shopping, or optional KL Tower Observation Deck visit.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Kuala Lumpur International Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Malaysia.

fields.name: Arrival in Bali
fields.title: Arrival in Bali
fields.description: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport, Denpasar, where our representative will welcome you. Transfer to your hotel in Kuta or Legian and complete the check-in formalities. Spend the evening relaxing at Kuta Beach and enjoy Bali's famous sunset before exploring nearby cafés and shopping streets.

fields.name: Ubud & Kintamani Tour
fields.title: Ubud & Kintamani Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day tour of Bali's cultural heart. Visit Tegenungan Waterfall, Tegalalang Rice Terrace, a traditional coffee plantation, Tirta Empul Holy Spring Temple, and Kintamani Volcano View Point overlooking Mount Batur and Lake Batur. Optional Bali Swing experience is available before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Nusa Dua & Tanah Lot Sunset
fields.title: Nusa Dua & Tanah Lot Sunset
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the beautiful Nusa Dua Beach and the famous Water Blow viewpoint. Continue to the iconic Tanah Lot Temple, one of Bali's most photographed sea temples, and witness a breathtaking sunset over the Indian Ocean.

fields.name: Leisure Day / Optional Nusa Penida Tour
fields.title: Leisure Day / Optional Nusa Penida Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a free day or choose an optional full-day Nusa Penida Island tour. Visit Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach, and Crystal Bay. Guests staying in Bali may enjoy shopping, beach clubs, spa treatments, or optional ATV rides and water sports.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Bali.

fields.name: Arrival in Hanoi
fields.title: Arrival in Hanoi
fields.description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport, Hanoi, where our representative will welcome you. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in process. In the evening, explore Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and Hanoi Old Quarter. Enjoy local Vietnamese cuisine and shopping before returning to the hotel.

fields.name: Ha Long Bay Cruise
fields.title: Ha Long Bay Cruise
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Ha Long Bay. Cruise through spectacular limestone islands, caves, floating fishing villages, and emerald waters. Enjoy a seafood lunch on board (optional depending on package) and return to Hanoi in the evening.

fields.name: Hanoi to Da Nang
fields.title: Hanoi to Da Nang
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a half-day Hanoi city tour covering Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum (outside view), Tran Quoc Pagoda, Temple of Literature, and the Old Quarter. Later, transfer to the airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax.

fields.name: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
fields.title: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the famous Ba Na Hills via one of the world's longest cable cars. Explore the iconic Golden Bridge, French Village, Fantasy Park, and beautiful mountain landscapes before returning to Da Nang.

fields.name: Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City
fields.title: Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Marble Mountains and Dragon Bridge before transferring to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival, enjoy a city tour covering Notre-Dame Cathedral (outside view), Central Post Office, Opera House (outside view), and Ben Thanh Market.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Vietnam.

fields.name: Arrival in Maldives
fields.title: Arrival in Maldives
fields.description: Arrive at Velana International Airport (Malé), where our representative will welcome you. Transfer to your resort or guesthouse via speedboat or domestic transfer. Check in and spend the rest of the day relaxing on the beach while enjoying the beautiful sunset over the Indian Ocean.

fields.name: Leisure & Water Activities
fields.title: Leisure & Water Activities
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a relaxing day at the resort. Explore the crystal-clear lagoon or participate in optional activities such as snorkeling, scuba diving, kayaking, paddleboarding, or jet skiing. Spend the evening enjoying the peaceful island atmosphere.

fields.name: Sandbank & Dolphin Cruise
fields.title: Sandbank & Dolphin Cruise
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy an optional sandbank excursion where you can relax on a secluded island surrounded by turquoise waters. Later, embark on an optional dolphin-watching cruise and witness playful dolphins in their natural habitat during sunset.

fields.name: Island Exploration & Leisure
fields.title: Island Exploration & Leisure
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy free time to explore the island, relax at the beach, or indulge in a rejuvenating spa treatment (optional). Guests may also choose optional activities such as sunset fishing, island hopping, or a romantic private beach dinner.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the resort and transfer to Velana International Airport by speedboat or domestic flight for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of the Maldives.

fields.name: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Transfer to Kandy
fields.title: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Transfer to Kandy
fields.description: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport, Colombo, where our representative will welcome you. Proceed to Kandy via Pinnawala (optional elephant orphanage visit). En route, visit a spice garden before checking into your hotel. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Sri Lankan cultural dance performance.

fields.name: Kandy & Nuwara Eliya Excursion
fields.title: Kandy & Nuwara Eliya Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Royal Botanical Garden, Ramboda Waterfall, a tea plantation, and a tea factory. Continue to Nuwara Eliya, known as "Little England," for a city tour covering Gregory Lake and Victoria Park before returning to Kandy.

fields.name: Kandy to Bentota
fields.title: Kandy to Bentota
fields.description: After breakfast, travel to Bentota, one of Sri Lanka's most popular beach destinations. Visit a Turtle Hatchery and enjoy an optional Madu River Boat Safari through mangrove forests. Relax on Bentota Beach and enjoy the coastal scenery.

fields.name: Bentota to Colombo via Galle
fields.title: Bentota to Colombo via Galle
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed towards Colombo via the historic city of Galle. Explore the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, lighthouse, colonial streets, and seaside promenade before continuing to Colombo. Check in to your hotel and relax.

fields.name: Colombo City Tour
fields.title: Colombo City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided Colombo city tour covering Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, Old Parliament Building, Galle Face Green, Colombo National Museum (outside view), and Lotus Tower (photo stop). Spend the evening shopping at Pettah Market, ODEL, or One Galle Face Mall.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Sri Lanka.

fields.name: Arrival in Dubai
fields.title: Arrival in Dubai
fields.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport, where our representative will welcome you. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, enjoy a Marina Dhow Cruise with an international buffet dinner, live entertainment, and breathtaking views of Dubai Marina's illuminated skyline.

fields.name: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa
fields.title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour covering Jumeirah Beach, Burj Al Arab (photo stop), Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis The Palm (photo stop), Dubai Museum (outside view), Al Fahidi Historical District, Gold Souk, and Spice Souk. In the evening, visit Dubai Mall and enjoy the Dubai Fountain Show. Guests may optionally visit the Burj Khalifa Observation Deck (124th Floor).

fields.name: Desert Safari Experience
fields.title: Desert Safari Experience
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy free time for shopping or relaxation. In the afternoon, proceed for an exciting Desert Safari featuring thrilling dune bashing, camel rides, sandboarding, henna painting, traditional Arabic hospitality, BBQ dinner, Tanoura dance, and live entertainment under the stars.

fields.name: Abu Dhabi City Tour
fields.title: Abu Dhabi City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, travel to Abu Dhabi and visit the magnificent Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Continue past Emirates Palace, Etihad Towers, Corniche, Heritage Village, and Ferrari World (photo stop on Yas Island). Return to Dubai in the evening.

fields.name: Leisure Day / Optional Attractions
fields.title: Leisure Day / Optional Attractions
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a free day or choose optional attractions such as Museum of the Future, Dubai Frame, Miracle Garden (seasonal), Global Village (seasonal), IMG Worlds of Adventure, Aquaventure Waterpark, or Ski Dubai. Spend your final evening shopping at Mall of the Emirates or Dubai Mall.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Dubai International Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of the UAE.

fields.name: Arrival in Riyadh
fields.title: Arrival in Riyadh
fields.description: Arrive at King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh, where our representative will welcome you. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, visit Boulevard Riyadh City (seasonal) or enjoy leisure time exploring local cafés and shopping malls.

fields.name: Riyadh City Tour
fields.title: Riyadh City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day city tour covering Kingdom Centre Sky Bridge, Al Masmak Fortress, National Museum, Murabba Historical Palace, Diriyah (UNESCO World Heritage Site), and traditional Souq Al Zal. Return to the hotel in the evening.

fields.name: Riyadh to AlUla
fields.title: Riyadh to AlUla
fields.description: After breakfast, transfer to AlUla by domestic flight or road (depending on package). Visit the spectacular Elephant Rock, Maraya Concert Hall (photo stop), and enjoy the stunning desert landscapes before checking into your hotel.

fields.name: AlUla Heritage Tour – Transfer to Jeddah
fields.title: AlUla Heritage Tour – Transfer to Jeddah
fields.description: After breakfast, explore Hegra (Madain Saleh), Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for its ancient Nabataean tombs and rock-cut monuments. Later, transfer to Jeddah by domestic flight and check into your hotel.

fields.name: Jeddah City Tour
fields.title: Jeddah City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour covering Al Balad Heritage District, Nassif House, Floating Mosque, Jeddah Corniche, King Fahd Fountain (photo stop), Red Sea Waterfront, and traditional markets. Spend the evening shopping or relaxing along the Corniche.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to King Abdulaziz International Airport, Jeddah, for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Saudi Arabia.

fields.name: Arrival in Doha
fields.title: Arrival in Doha
fields.description: Arrive at Hamad International Airport. Meet our representative and transfer to the hotel. Check in and relax. Evening free for leisure or visit Souq Waqif for shopping and local dining.

fields.name: Doha City Tour
fields.title: Doha City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed for Doha city sightseeing covering Corniche, Museum of Islamic Art photo stop, Katara Cultural Village, The Pearl Qatar, Lusail Boulevard, and Souq Waqif. Evening free for shopping.

fields.name: Leisure / Optional Desert Safari
fields.title: Leisure / Optional Desert Safari
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy leisure time or choose an optional desert safari with dune bashing, camel ride, Inland Sea view, and sunset photography. Optional dhow cruise can also be arranged.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Hamad International Airport for your return journey.

fields.name: Arrival in Muscat
fields.title: Arrival in Muscat
fields.description: Arrive at Muscat International Airport. Meet our representative and transfer to the hotel. Evening free to relax or explore Mutrah Corniche.

fields.name: Muscat City Tour
fields.title: Muscat City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Royal Opera House photo stop, Al Alam Palace photo stop, Portuguese Forts photo stop, Mutrah Souq, and Mutrah Corniche.

fields.name: Nizwa Fort & Souq
fields.title: Nizwa Fort & Souq
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to Nizwa. Visit Nizwa Fort, Nizwa Souq, traditional markets, and local date shops. Return to Muscat by evening.

fields.name: Wadi Shab & Bimmah Sinkhole
fields.title: Wadi Shab & Bimmah Sinkhole
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy an optional full-day coastal excursion to Wadi Shab and Bimmah Sinkhole. Experience scenic landscapes, clear pools, and beautiful mountain routes.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Muscat International Airport for your onward journey.

fields.name: Arrival in Baku
fields.title: Arrival in Baku
fields.description: Arrive at Heydar Aliyev International Airport, where our representative will welcome you. Transfer to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. In the evening, explore the beautiful Baku Boulevard, Caspian Sea Promenade, and Nizami Street for shopping and dining.

fields.name: Baku City Tour
fields.title: Baku City Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour covering Icherisheher (Old City), Maiden Tower (photo stop), Shirvanshah's Palace (photo stop), Flame Towers, Highland Park, Martyrs' Lane, and the iconic Heydar Aliyev Center (photo stop). Spend the evening shopping at Nizami Street.

fields.name: Gobustan & Absheron Tour
fields.title: Gobustan & Absheron Tour
fields.description: After breakfast, visit Gobustan National Park, famous for its prehistoric rock carvings and mud volcanoes (subject to weather). Continue to Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanar Dag, the naturally burning mountain that has fascinated travelers for centuries.

fields.name: Gabala Day Excursion
fields.title: Gabala Day Excursion
fields.description: After breakfast, proceed to the picturesque mountain town of Gabala. Visit Nohur Lake, Tufandag Mountain Resort, and enjoy an optional cable car ride with breathtaking views of the Caucasus Mountains. Return to Baku in the evening.

fields.name: Departure
fields.title: Departure
fields.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Heydar Aliyev International Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Azerbaijan.
